ltas_db.desc: 1/3-oct long-term spectrum, 125 Hz-6.3 kHz, dB RMS difference (level-normalised on 250-4000)

mel_env_db.desc: mean log-mel envelope (typical frame), dB RMS difference 80 Hz-6 kHz

mfcc.desc: Euclidean distance of mean MFCC c1-c19

band_shares.desc: total-variation distance of the <250/250-1k/1-4k/>4k energy shares

centroid.desc: |log2| ratio of the power-weighted spectral centroid (octaves)

flatness.desc: |log10| ratio of the median core-band (250-4000) spectral flatness

noise_floor.desc: inter-harmonic floor (p10 of bins per 1/3-oct band re band mean), mean |dB| difference

modulation.desc: modulation spectrum 0.5-20 Hz of 4 band envelopes: 1 - Pearson r (shape) + depth/12 dB

pitch.desc: pitch behaviour: |d vibrato|/4 c + |d band pitch-deviation std|/6 c + |d partial spread|/6 c + |log d vibrato peakiness|/log 4

reverb.desc: side-from-mid identified response, dB RMS difference at 10-300 ms (mono: fixed 15 dB)

dynamics.desc: |d 100 ms level std|/1.5 + |d fast fluct|/1 + |d crest|/2 + |d LRA|/2 (sum)

accent.desc: waltz beat accent ('u a a'): |d brightness contrast|/2 dB + |d bright-pair balance|/2 + |d level contrast|/2

first_sound_s.desc: first 10 ms frame above (LUFS-I - 16 dB; original -45.5 dBFS); target 0.00

last_sound_s.desc: end of the last 10 ms frame above (LUFS-I - 16 dB); target <= 13.75

tail_end_s.desc: end of the last 10 ms frame above (LUFS-I - 40 dB): any residual tail

lufs_integrated.desc: EBU R128 integrated loudness (ffmpeg ebur128); target -29.5 +-0.5

clicks.desc: isolated AR(32)-residual spikes > 16 robust sigma (< 3 ms; hits within 60 ms count once)

ltas_dist_db.desc: 1/3-oct LTAS distance 125-6300 Hz, dB RMS (bands floored at -45 dB re 250-4k)

mel_env_dist_db.desc: mean log-mel envelope distance 80-6000 Hz, dB RMS

mfcc_dist.desc: Euclidean distance of mean MFCC c1-c19 (librosa units)

rolloff95_hz.desc: 95 % energy roll-off of the long-term spectrum

flatness.desc: median spectral flatness inside 250-4000 Hz (higher = noisier / denser)

noise_floor.desc: per 1/3-oct band 250-4k: median over frames of p10(bin power)/mean(bin power), dB (more negative = cleaner valleys)

modulation.desc: band-envelope fluctuation, RMS dB in modulation ranges 0.5-2 / 2-8 / 8-20 Hz

vibrato_rms_c.desc: 3.5-9 Hz pitch modulation of partial tracks >= 0.4 s, cents RMS (weighted median)

pitch_instability_c.desc: std of the 0.2 s-smoothed deviation from 12-TET in 3 register bands (240-470/480-940/1400-2500 Hz), mean of bands: per-note mistuning + bends + wow

texture_peaks_per_frame.desc: median number of spectral peaks per 46 ms frame in 240-2600 Hz (>= -30 dB re frame max, 6 dB prominence): texture density

glide_share.desc: weighted share of partial-track frames moving faster than 600 cents/s (portamento / bends)

partial_spread_c.desc: circular std of simultaneous partials' deviations (ensemble detune / mistuning), weighted median

mono_fold_db.desc: mono fold-down: std over 300-3000 Hz of 10log10(P_mid / mean(P_L, P_R)) in 2.7 Hz bins (comb filtering in mono)

reverb_ir_env_db.desc: side-from-mid identified response energy (dB re peak) at 10,20,30,50,75,100,150,200,300 ms; None = mono/no side

level_fast_fluct_db.desc: std of 20 ms level minus its 0.3 s moving average (shimmer / articulation)

crest_50ms_db.desc: median crest factor of 50 ms windows

fastest_drop_db_s.desc: 2nd percentile of the 20 ms level slope (how fast sound can fall: articulation + room)

accent_uaa.desc: per-beat brightness tilt L(1-4k)-L(250-500) by beat position, rotated to start on the darkest ('u a a' = dark, bright, bright)

tempo_bpm.desc: beat-grid fit to the onset envelope, 110-190 BPM, 0.1 BPM steps

key.desc: Krumhansl-Kessler best key on mean chroma

onsets_per_bar.desc: librosa onsets in the active part / bars at the measured tempo

harmonic_rocking.desc: chroma self-similarity at a 2-bar lag (own tempo); with lag1bar: original rocks i<->vii (lag2 high, lag1 low)

bar_levels_db.desc: RMS per 1.19 s window from the first sound, dB re the median window (dynamic arch)

start_level_db.desc: first 0.5 s RMS re the median 0.5 s window

end_hold_db.desc: RMS of the last 1.0 s before the last sound re the median (held tonic vs fade)

legato_gap_fraction.desc: share of 10 ms frames > 20 dB under the median level

chroma_seq_sim_transposed.desc: same, best of 12 chroma rotations and of time scales 0.94-1.06 (catches transposed / tempo-changed copies)

fingerprint_match.desc: share of candidate peak-pair hashes that match the original with one consistent time offset (pitch shift searched +-9 semitones); detects reused audio
